data.title: Events are append-only: nothing is edited or deleted, and task delete writes a task.deleted event
data.why: From CLAUDE.md. A journal that can be edited cannot be merged by git without conflicts or trusted as history. task delete therefore writes a task.deleted event, and its message says so plainly, because promising erasure in an append-only journal would be a lie. Corrections are new events through the CLI; files under .kadence/events are never hand-edited.
data.rejected: Deleting or rewriting the event files: breaks the history and the conflict-free merge, and a delete message would promise an erasure that git history does not honour
